# Feigi Web

> Web design for small businesses in Lorain County and Northeast Ohio.
> Sites from $500, with a free mockup before you pay anything.

Feigi Web is a one-person web design studio run by Michael Feigi, serving
small businesses across Lorain County and Northeast Ohio. Every project
starts with a free mockup — the client sees their finished site before
paying anything. No long-term contracts, and the domain always stays in
the client's name.

## Service area

Elyria, Lorain, Avon, Avon Lake, North Ridgeville, Amherst, Sheffield Lake,
Oberlin, Vermilion, and the surrounding Lorain County / Northeast Ohio area.

## Pricing

- Starter — $500. Up to 5 pages, mobile-friendly design, Google Business Profile setup.
- Growth — $1,500. Custom multi-page design, booking or quote-request forms, basic SEO setup.
- Complete — $3,000. Online ordering or booking system, ongoing SEO and content.

Ongoing maintenance and support is a flat monthly fee. There is no long-term contract.

## Common questions

- How much does a small business website cost? Feigi Web builds start at $500 one-time.
- Do I pay before seeing anything? No. You see a free mockup first, then decide.
- Who owns the domain? You do. It is registered in your name and goes with you.
- How long does it take? Most sites go live in two to three weeks.
